taste:
Diet Coke (Pint) tastes crisp and sharply sweet, with lively carbonation that makes the first sip feel distinctly fizzy. The flavour is recognisably cola, but the sharpness is as noticeable as the sweetness. Served ice-cold from the draught lines, it is a refreshing choice if you want a cold drink with a pronounced bubbly mouthfeel rather than something still.

The generous pint serving suits sipping alongside food. Its crisp character helps clear the palate between bites, particularly when you want a refreshing contrast to a richer meal. Expect an assertive fizz rather than a gentle sparkle, with sweetness remaining part of the flavour despite the absence of sugar.
